no_imputation: Only measured sources receive nonzero weight. If no source measured a query, return exactly zero response / target control mean. Never silently restore GP imputation.
adaptive_temperature: For each target task, compare temperatures by leave-one-source-context-out validation. Held validation-context weights are softmax[-(D_context_to_outer_target-minD)/ell], computed ONLY from outer-target and allowed-source controls with the existing variance-weighted distance and source-source median scale. Each source-validation query pool includes ALL held-source targets, including unsupported queries. Thus temperature selection depends on target controls and the allowed source pool, never on outer-target perturbation responses.
source_scoring: No output clipping in source validation or prediction. NMSE on all held-source targets including unsupported cases; fixed256-candidate128-query L1/L2 panels. Existing target-control-conditioned source-validation weights retained.
selection: Retune temperature for this observed-only/no-shrinkage/no-clip model: maximize target-conditioned source-validation mean(L1,L2) subject NMSE <=1.05 times its own fixedT.25 baseline. Tie-break lower NMSE then larger temperature.
primary_model: Use observed-source responses only, zero covariance shrinkage, relative posterior variance weighting, target-adaptive temperature, no output clip.
target_evaluation: All PIE test rows; 6642 ordered genes; frozen published PIE scorer
numeric_guard: No-shrink OT uses sample covariance with only existing eigen floor1e-8 for numerical safety; record whether floor is activated. The same frozen128D control basis is used by both shrinkage conditions.
gp_role: Each source GP is retained for relative posterior variance. Point predictions are observed mean responses; unknown-source values and weights are zero. Gene priors influence reliability weights, not unmeasured response generation.
